answer: Five agents grade each submission and the two furthest from the median lose their bond. A sponsor's own reward burns when its recruit is caught, so vouching is expensive and there is little reason to vouch for a stranger. Replay every submission against the ledger instead of matching names, because a copied answer under a new label passes any name check. A farm up the trellis of sponsorships pays twice, once for the bond and once for the recruit's failure, and its standing sinks to the nadir while it waits. A cleared bond returns with a jade tag, a burned one returns nothing.
